schema_note: v2.0 lifecycle O&M ledger framework responding to the 'who pays to keep it running' gap. Machine-readable companion of proposal.md section '全生命周期运营账本框架'. Funding type references align with funding-matrix.json; responsible roles align with the four-link accountability chain.

om_accounts.responsible_role_zh: 公园管理方/站厅运营方（运行监督环节）
om_accounts.boundary_zh: 以正式立项与管养分工为准
om_accounts.boundary_en: Per formal approvals and maintenance division

om_accounts.responsible_role_zh: 具名 accountable_operator（准入环节具名）
运营方+策展章程（复审问责环节）
基础设施运营方（运行监督环节）
om_accounts.boundary_zh: 供电与数据合规审查前置

om_accounts.responsible_role_zh: 第三方机构+属地主管（复审问责环节）
om_accounts.boundary_zh: 测量纪律不删失败样本

applies_to: switched-back / exited projects recovery and handover
om_accounts.responsible_role_zh: 属地主管+原运营方双联交接（退出环节）
om_accounts.responsible_role_en: District authority + outgoing operator dual handover (exit link)

method_discipline_zh: 本框架不含任何数值估算，运营科目与资金衔接均为建议路径；收支平衡结论仅在试点基线测量完成且收益口径经审计定义后，由属地主管与具名运营方联合复核发布，并随 90 天公开复审滚动更新。
method_discipline_en: This framework contains no numeric estimates; accounts and funding linkages are proposed paths only. Break-even conclusions are published only after pilot baseline measurement is complete and the revenue scope is audit-defined, jointly reviewed by the district authority and the named operator, and rolled forward with the 90-day public review.
boundary_zh: 全部为概念建议（建议/待协商），不构成政府或资金方承诺。
boundary_en: All conceptual proposals pending negotiation; not commitments by governments or funders.
